@graph.name: Industrial Millwright & Mill Maintenance
@graph.description: Machinery installation, precision shaft and laser alignment, bearing replacement, mill maintenance, and mechanical commissioning for mining and industrial operations.

@graph.name: Welding & Fabrication
@graph.description: Certified structural and field welding, custom fabrication, pipe welding on carbon steel, stainless, and alloy materials for industrial and mining applications.

@graph.name: Painting & Sandblasting
@graph.description: Abrasive blasting to bare metal and industrial paint application on heavy equipment, structural steel, tanks, and piping for corrosion protection in Northern Ontario environments.

@graph.name: Surface Construction
@graph.description: Structural steel erection, site infrastructure, concrete formwork, equipment pads, stairs, walkways, and industrial facility modifications at mining and industrial sites.

@graph.name: Underground Construction
@graph.description: Underground mechanical installation, bulkhead and support structures, piping, and equipment installation for mining operations — certified crews, subsurface experience.

@graph.name: Confined Space Work & Confined Space Watch
@graph.description: Certified confined space entry and attendant watch for tanks, vessels, silos, tunnels, and permit-required spaces with atmospheric monitoring and emergency retrieval.

@graph.name: Working at Heights
@graph.description: Certified elevated work, fall protection system setup, rope access, aerial work platform operation, and headframe and conveyor structure maintenance.

@graph.name: Hoisting & Rigging
@graph.description: Certified rigging for heavy equipment picks, critical lift planning, sling and hardware inspection, and underground hoist and shaft work coordination.

@graph.name: Exploration & Work Camp Set Up
@graph.description: Work camp assembly, exploration support infrastructure, temporary power and water setup, trailer positioning, and site clearing for remote Northern Ontario programs.

@graph.name: Core Farms & Core Farm Relocation
@graph.description: Core farm construction, core box racking setup, full relocation services, core storage facility installation, and site restoration for exploration and mining programs.

@graph.name: Road Building
@graph.description: Access road and haul road construction, grading, culvert installation, road base preparation, and mine site road building for year-round heavy equipment use in Northern Ontario.

@graph.name: Pipe Grooving & Installation
@graph.description: Steel pipe grooving 2–24 inch, grooved coupling installation, HDPE poly pipe, process piping, pipe supports, and pressure testing for mining and industrial sites.

@graph.name: Shutdown & Turnaround Support
